metadata.title: Claude Code, Plugin Structure.
metadata.purpose: Answer whether every plugin component lives inside .claude-plugin alongside the manifest, or somewhere else, using the plugin-structure skill's own SKILL.md exact-filename rule as the concrete case. Lands the carry-out that only the manifest lives inside .claude-plugin -- everything else sits at the plugin's root and only auto-loads if the filename is exactly right.
metadata.anchor_pair: B02 -> B03 (skills auto-discovery requires the file to be named exactly SKILL.md; rename it and the skill silently vanishes, no error)

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes their commands folder goes inside dot-claude-plugin, right beside the manifest. It doesn't — only the manifest lives there. Everything else sits at the plugin's root. So where does the rest actually go?

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'My commands folder — does it go inside .claude-plugin?', hesitates on 'inside', corrects to 'outside', lands the real question

props.text:
My commands folder —
does it go inside
.claude-plugin?

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 20-35 word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('inside' -> 'outside') is visible on a late frame.

beats.narration_text: The manifest — plugin.json — lives inside .claude-plugin, and it needs exactly one field: name, in kebab-case. Everything else lives at the plugin's root, one level up: commands, agents, skills, hooks. Drop a file in the right directory, and it's auto-discovered — no registration, no import step.

shot.new_visual_element: A manifest card fixed inside a .claude-plugin folder icon; four component folders drawn at the root level beside it, one level up

production_viz.label: One field, one level up
production_viz.mechanic: A folder icon labelled '.claude-plugin' sits left, a card labelled 'plugin.json — name:' fixed inside it. To the right, at the same vertical level as the .claude-plugin folder itself (one level up from the manifest), four folder icons draw in one by one: commands, agents, skills, hooks. A thin bracket labels the .claude-plugin folder and the four sibling folders together as 'plugin root'.

beats.narration_text: Five kinds of component can live at that root. Commands and agents are just markdown files — drop one in the right folder and it works. Skills are pickier: each one needs its own subdirectory, and inside it, a file named exactly SKILL.md — not readme, not skill dot m d in lowercase. Get that filename right, and the skill shows up automatically.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR — a skills/ subdirectory, a file renaming itself into place as exactly SKILL.md, the skill card lighting up

production_viz.label: THE ANCHOR — named exactly right, it lights up
production_viz.mechanic: Five small cards fade in left to right: commands, agents, skills, hooks, MCP. Four fade to a resting dim state. THE ANCHOR. The 'skills' card grows and opens into a subdirectory box; inside it a file name types itself out letter by letter until it reads exactly 'SKILL.md' in teal. The moment the last letter lands, the whole card brightens and a small skill-card thumbnail lights up beside it. THIS EXACT SEQUENCE RETURNS AT B03.

beats.narration_text: Rename that same file to readme dot m d, and nothing errors — the skill just disappears from the list, silently. Auto-discovery holds exactly as advertised when the name is right; get it wrong, in this one specific way, and it fails without a word.

shot.new_visual_element: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — the same file renamed to readme.md; the skill card goes dark, no error text, just gone

production_viz.label: THE ANCHOR RETURNS — renamed, and gone
production_viz.mechanic: THE B02 SEQUENCE RETURNS, identical: the same subdirectory, the same file. This time the letters retype themselves into 'readme.md' instead. No strike mark, no error banner — the lit skill-card thumbnail beside it simply fades to nothing, and the space where it was stays empty. A line of small italic text appears beneath: 'no error. no warning. just gone.'

beats.narration_text: Only the manifest lives inside .claude-plugin. Everything else lives at the plugin's root, and it only loads automatically if the filename is exactly right.

props.quote: Only the manifest lives inside .claude-plugin. Everything else lives at the plugin's root, and it only loads automatically if the filename is exactly right.
props.sparkLine: Manifest inside. Everything else, exactly named, at the root.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. Create a plugin called doc-linter with a lint-docs command, a doc-reviewer agent, and a markdown-style skill. Watch three things when Claude answers: is plugin.json placed inside .claude-plugin, not at the plugin's root? Are the commands, agents, and skills folders sitting at the root, not nested inside .claude-plugin? And inside the skill's folder, is the file named exactly SKILL.md — not readme, not lowercase? Liam, in for Bear.
